# Your title

This page answers how the interface presents and responds. Describe layout, interaction states, keyboard and accessibility requirements, and visual acceptance. Components, style variables, and source paths belong in the architecture page; the complete user journey belongs in a Use Case.

## Layout

Describe the regions of the interface and what each one shows.

## Interaction States

Describe each state the user can see, what moves the interface between states, and what is preserved across them.

## Keyboard and Accessibility

State the keyboard paths and accessibility requirements every screen must meet.

## Visual Acceptance

List the viewports, data volumes, and themes to check, and the result each check must show.
